description: Website Crawler. Fast HTTP pull of public HTML with no browser session. Ideal when the first response already contains the content you need. Credit cost: 1 credit per call.

allow_redirects.description: Whether BrowserSolver should chase HTTP redirects for this fetch. Default: true.

fields.description: Comma-separated list of fields to keep in the response, with dot notation for nested fields (e.g. name,location.city). Does not change the credit cost.

query.description: Public URL to retrieve with the Crawler tier (plain HTTP, no JavaScript). Include http:// or https://.

return_page_source.description: Choose between processed markup and the exact bytes from the origin. Default: false.

name: website_crawler
title: Website Crawler
